title: Pithyx catalog index signature v1
description: `index.json.sig` next to `index.json` of a catalog's branch (D328): Ed25519 signatures (RFC 8032, pure, no prehash) over the exact bytes of `index.json`, without any canonical form, so the box verifies the bytes it read before it parses them. A box accepts the index when at least one signature is by a key it trusts for the index's channel and every signature by such a key verifies; signatures by keys it does not know are ignored, so CI can sign with an old and a new key while boxes move to the new one. Custom catalogs are never signed. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

keyId.description: The name of the key, as the box knows it, for example `pithyx-catalog-2026`.

signature.description: The 64 bytes of the signature in base64 with padding (RFC 4648, section 4).
